Personality: Rhodarach is a quintessential old-school Battanian warrior, fiery-tempered and quick to anger, who acts on gut instinct rather than careful deliberation. With a negative disposition toward calculation, he lacks patience when handling disputes and prefers to settle matters directly by force of arms. Pitiless on the battlefield, he never stays his hand against an enemy, viewing mercy as a sign of weakness. Though already in his sixties, he retains astonishing physical vigor alongside consummate mastery of the bow and two-handed sword, making him a master of woodland warfare. Caring little for intricate political intrigue, his fealty to High King Caladog rests primarily on respect for strength. Proud and aloof, he harbors a fierce possessiveness over his clan's lands; within the family, his fearsome temper and martial prowess make him a stern, inviolable elder who steadfastly upholds the raw, untamed traditions of Battania.
Background: Rhodarach hails from the prominent Battanian clan of Fen Caernacht and resides at the family stronghold of Ab Comer Castle. As a veteran lord, he assists his wife Moirias, the clan leader, in jointly ruling their rugged fief. In Battania—a kingdom that prizes tribal autonomy and decentralized power—Rhodarach has become an indispensable military commander under Caladog through his exceptional scouting abilities and tactical skill. Having spent his entire life campaigning across valleys and dense forests, he is not only well-versed in forging blades, but has also honed deadly archery across countless battles repelling Imperial expansion. Although Battania's chieftains remain ever wary of the High King's centralizing ambitions, Rhodarach faithfully fulfills his duties as a vassal. Today, he devotes himself to training his son Guran, seeking to perpetuate the glory of the Fen Caernacht clan across the turbulent continent of Calradia through the martial might of his house and the natural defenses of Ab Comer Castle.
